sources.author: Tao Li
sources.title: Daily mean discharge and suspended sediment concentration from 2015 to 2021 at Lijin station
sources.original_source: Chinese Hydrological Yearbook, as attributed by the archive author
sources.modifications: None; original XLSX retained byte-for-byte. The common-period count excludes the extra 2022-01-01 record without altering the file.
sources.daily_definition: Source calendar date labels retained. The workbook does not specify its civil-day timezone convention.
sources.quality_note: No per-record instrument-quality flags are supplied in the workbook. Public archiving is not independent validation of the original measurements.

sources.station: Mississippi River at St. Louis, MO
sources.author: U.S. Geological Survey
sources.license: US Government work in the public domain
sources.modifications: None; the downloaded API response and native ft³/s values are retained. The conversion factor is documented, not applied to the downloadable original file.
sources.daily_definition: USGS daily mean (statistic 00003); original calendar date labels retained, not interpreted as simultaneous UTC instantaneous observations.
sources.quality_note: 39 days estimated, including 15 also equipment-flagged; 2 provider-interpolated days. No project interpolation, imputation or generated observations.

publication_note: Real daily discharge models for Lijin and St. Louis only. Legacy synthetic experiments are not used by this site. Forecasts extend a historical cutoff and are not live operational forecasts.
